preRKE2Commands:
sh -eu -c 'set -eu
umask 077
for d in /opt /opt/rke2-artifacts /etc/rancher /etc/rancher/rke2 /etc/rancher/rke2/config.yaml.d; do test ! -L "$d"; done
install -d -o root -g root -m 0700 /opt/rke2-artifacts /etc/rancher/rke2/config.yaml.d
tmp=$(mktemp -d /opt/rke2-artifacts/.qualification.XXXXXX)
trap '"'"'rm -rf "$tmp"'"'"' EXIT
curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --proto '"'"'=https'"'"' --proto-redir '"'"'=https'"'"' --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 1800 --retry 2 --output "$tmp/sha256sum-amd64.txt" https://github.com/rancher/rke2/releases/download/v1.36.4%2Brke2r1/sha256sum-amd64.txt
printf '"'"'%s  %s\n'"'"' 8e12805c4bda79bec2fd20c89f705af3cb2ed11ea8854dc4937fca41b124b57a "$tmp/sha256sum-amd64.txt" | sha256sum --check --status
chown root:root "$tmp/sha256sum-amd64.txt"
chmod 0600 "$tmp/sha256sum-amd64.txt"
test ! -L /opt/rke2-artifacts/sha256sum-amd64.txt
mv -T "$tmp/sha256sum-amd64.txt" /opt/rke2-artifacts/sha256sum-amd64.txt
curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --proto '"'"'=https'"'"' --proto-redir '"'"'=https'"'"' --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 1800 --retry 2 --output "$tmp/rke2.linux-amd64.tar.gz" https://github.com/rancher/rke2/releases/download/v1.36.4%2Brke2r1/rke2.linux-amd64.tar.gz
printf '"'"'%s  %s\n'"'"' 7bcbd3167d6947e1d79cdf722acdc740b28021fefb50dd5b974a1980776d4079 "$tmp/rke2.linux-amd64.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --status
chown root:root "$tmp/rke2.linux-amd64.tar.gz"
chmod 0600 "$tmp/rke2.linux-amd64.tar.gz"
test ! -L /opt/rke2-artifacts/rke2.linux-amd64.tar.gz
mv -T "$tmp/rke2.linux-amd64.tar.gz" /opt/rke2-artifacts/rke2.linux-amd64.tar.gz
curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --proto '"'"'=https'"'"' --proto-redir '"'"'=https'"'"' --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 1800 --retry 2 --output "$tmp/rke2-images.linux-amd64.tar.zst" https://github.com/rancher/rke2/releases/download/v1.36.4%2Brke2r1/rke2-images.linux-amd64.tar.zst
printf '"'"'%s  %s\n'"'"' 03b82bfa0eb5df65fdedbac17c4a16a1c436d087d0026f1f172f486c27449cbb "$tmp/rke2-images.linux-amd64.tar.zst" | sha256sum --check --status
chown root:root "$tmp/rke2-images.linux-amd64.tar.zst"
chmod 0600 "$tmp/rke2-images.linux-amd64.tar.zst"
test ! -L /opt/rke2-artifacts/rke2-images.linux-amd64.tar.zst
mv -T "$tmp/rke2-images.linux-amd64.tar.zst" /opt/rke2-artifacts/rke2-images.linux-amd64.tar.zst
curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --proto '"'"'=https'"'"' --proto-redir '"'"'=https'"'"' --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 1800 --retry 2 --output "$tmp/install.sh" https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rancher/rke2/v1.36.4%2Brke2r1/install.sh
printf '"'"'%s  %s\n'"'"' 42983c86d1da64a92061d83afb57630cedd69241989f1b0673f3db6c3d92ee6b "$tmp/install.sh" | sha256sum --check --status
chown root:root "$tmp/install.sh"
chmod 0700 "$tmp/install.sh"
test ! -L /opt/install.sh
mv -T "$tmp/install.sh" /opt/install.sh
printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'disable-default-registry-endpoint: true'"'"' > "$tmp/99-layersentry-qualification.yaml"
chmod 0600 "$tmp/99-layersentry-qualification.yaml"
test ! -L /etc/rancher/rke2/config.yaml.d/99-layersentry-qualification.yaml
mv -T "$tmp/99-layersentry-qualification.yaml" /etc/rancher/rke2/config.yaml.d/99-layersentry-qualification.yaml' || exit 1
